'''Brittany Cox''' (born 18 July 1988) is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with A3 Artists Agency in Los Angeles and Big Fish NW Talent in Seattle.

==Biography==
Cox is an American voice actress, born in Raleigh, North Carolina. In the [[Pokémon]] franchise, Cox first voiced {{mas|Lisia}} in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. She then joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced [[Sonia]].
